lines.text: This is it, arcade engineer: your own game, built with everything you’ve learned.
Write a one-page game design: the goal, the player, what clones do, your variables, your states and how it ends.
Clones for many enemies or items.
Get the smallest playable version working first (player + one rule).
Then add one feature at a time and test after each.
Show your game, explain one clever piece of code, and share what playtesters said.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
